items.title: Spotify’s new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
items.summary: The update comes as Billboard reported last month that Sony Music had requested the removal of more than 260,000 deepfake songs from digital platforms, nearly double the number the label disclosed in March.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million to deploy glove-wearing robots
items.summary: Genesis AI's novel approach to training dexterous robots earned it $500 million in Series A funding.
items.creator: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Upside Foods can now make a million pounds of chicken a year without killing any animals
items.summary: The first ever lab-grown hamburger cost $300,000 to make in 2013. Upside Foods says its cultivated chicken can now match the price range of “really high quality organic chicken."
items.creator: Amanda Silberling

items.title: Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a curated educational video platform for kids
items.summary: Alongside CEO Leslie Morgan, Hank Green set out to create the video platform he wished his kid had.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling
